pages.text:
ACTION-PACKED
Life goes better the more you’re prepared, and the newly-
designed Chrysler Pacifica is always thinking ahead. A clear
favorite among busy families, Pacifica builds-in impressive
capability with:
• 3.6L Pentastar® Variable Valve Timing (VVT) V6 engine
• 9-speed automatic transmission
• Standard Front Wheel Drive (FWD)
• Available All-Wheel Drive (AWD)
It all works to move 7 passengers in comfort, while innovative
safety and convenience features make for better days.
A range of trim levels cater to your particular lifestyle — find
your best match with:
• Pacifica LX
• Pacifica Select
• Pacifica Limited
• Pacifica Pinnacle®
Pinnacle® in Olive Green

A TRUE GLOW UP
For 2027, the newly-designed Chrysler Pacifica arrives
looking thoroughly refreshed. Its front fascia features bold
new lines with angular, vertical LED headlights connected by
a “piano keys” light bar that spans the width of the grille.
An enhanced Chrysler wing logo is artfully integrated in this
new face of Pacifica, as well as in the taillamp design.
Along with a choice of additional exterior paint colors and
wheel designs, the 2027 Pacifica assertively moves forward
with a new, modern stance.
Pinnacle® in Olive Green

pages.text:
PEOPLE PLEASER
Known for its sliding-door ease and exceptional level of
riding comforts, Chrysler Pacifica for 2027 offers even
more to love, including a new Blue Agave interior color
that comes standard on Pinnacle®.
SAFETY FIRST
Pacifica offers advanced features that help anticipate
and protect. For 2027, an upgraded Safety Sphere
Package includes:
• 360° Surround-View Camera1*
• New Turn Signal-Activated Blind Spot Monitoring (BSM)2
• ParkSense® Assist-Based Camera1 Activation3
• ParkSense Front/Rear Park Assist with Full Stop3
SEAMLESS TECH
The Uconnect® 5 system and its 10.1-inch touchscreen
host a sophisticated suite of technology services:
• Alexa Built-In4
• Amazon Fire TV® Built-In5
• Apple CarPlay®6 support
• Android AutoTM7 compatibility
• 19-speaker Harman Kardon® Premium Audio System
• Independent Uconnect Theater and Family Tech
Groups, for greater choice and flexibility
EVERYDAY INGENUITY
Pacifica is known for features that make your day better:
• Segment-exclusive Stow ‘n Go seating and
storage system8
• Available Stow ‘n Vac® integrated vacuum system
• Easy-Slide 2nd row captains chairs
• Heated, leather-wrapped steering wheel with
audio controls
*A note about this brochure: all disclosures can be found on the last page.
